claims.claim: Proved through deterministic regression that an eligible NO_CHANGE continuation after a CODE_FIX phase-VERIFICATION failure is admitted when the preserved pre-verification ResultPackage is valid under full root_base_sha-to-subject TASK changed-files authority even though predecessor FAILURE candidate.changed_files truthfully contains only the narrower failed-head-to-subject correction delta.

Proved through regression that canonical REPAIR Result.changed_files remains the complete stable original TASK delta required by TASK-057 and is not narrowed, rewritten, or replaced by the CODE_FIX correction-relative FAILURE delta.

Proved through regression that FAILURE candidate.changed_files retains its narrow per-RUN correction-relative authority and exact failed-head/correction lineage without being expanded or normalized to match the reusable ResultPackage.

Proved that genuine NO_CHANGE reuse still fails closed before canonical verification when the preserved pre-verification package itself has an invalid full-TASK changed-files set, wrong subject/head, wrong TASK/revision, malformed or conflicting local/transported state, incomplete ResultPackage, or incomplete TASK acceptance coverage; no Executor fallback, retry, or reroute occurs.

Modeled the full deterministic continuation topology of PRIMARY canonical verification failure followed by eligible NO_CHANGE verification failure, followed by authorized CODE_FIX REPAIR dispatching its selected Executor exactly once and failing only during canonical verification, followed by final explicitly authorized NO_CHANGE continuation admitted despite correction-relative versus root-relative changed-files inequality.

Proved that the AC5 continuation topology preserves exact latest failed_head_sha, continuation_of, original root_base_sha, TASK id/revision, historical/correction lineage, and subject identity at every step without rebasing, mutating, or substituting candidates.

Proved that the final eligible NO_CHANGE continuation in AC5 invokes zero native Executors and runs the canonical TASK verification list exactly once through Runtime completion, while the preceding CODE_FIX remains an ordinary exactly-one Executor dispatch and does not consume or depend on reusable-candidate state.

Verified that existing valid NO_CHANGE reuse, genuine fail-closed malformed/mismatched reuse cases, ordinary CODE_FIX REPAIR, historical REPAIR recovery, current-HEAD REPAIR, Runtime-owned verification/EVIDENCE, and no-retry/no-fallback/no-reroute regressions remain behaviorally unchanged outside the corrected changed-files authority comparison.

Preserved all worker, adapter, dispatcher, downstream repository, roadmap capability status, artifact schema, and publication surfaces without changes; implementation remains limited to the Runtime/Operator reusable-candidate decision boundary and focused deterministic regression coverage.
